title: Wendell and the Portrait
author: Felix Lockridge
blurb: Juniper Eriksen, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
